cover_dek: Washington and Moscow agreed on fuel supplies before the midterm elections.
big_headline: Russia will supply diesel fuel to the United States and the global market.
big_body: Donald Trump said Vladimir Putin agreed to supply over 300K tons immediately, add 500K tons for November, and deliver 1 million tons after.
pol_body: The European Securities and Markets Authority published an opinion on crypto-asset services involving certain stablecoins that do not comply with regulations.
biz_body: US President Donald Trump announced an agreement to buy Russian diesel. Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticized the move.
up_body: Cecabank, based in Spain, will withdraw from the Euribor panel, a group of banks that helps set interest rates.
